title: Here’s Where to Watch The National Dog Show 2026 Online for Free
summary: Hosted by John O'Hurley, you can stream the 25th annual dog show from Philadelphia on Thursday, Nov. 26.

How to Watch The National Dog Show 2026 Online, at a Glance:

When Does The National Dog Show 2026 Start ?

The National Dog Show happens on Thursday (Nov. 26) at Greater Philadelphia Expo Center & Fairgrounds in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with a start time of 12 p.m. ET/9 a.m. PT.

What TV Network Features The National Dog Show 2026?

The National Dog Show broadcasts on NBC, while it’s available to stream on Peacock .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During The National Dog Show 2026?

Singer Kendal Conrad is set to perform the American national anthem, “The Star-Spangled Banner.”

Where to Watch The National Dog Show 2026 Online for Free
